text: Power utilities plan their construction years in advance.
But neighbors plan alone. Each in its own document. On its own map.
Along the Savannah River, Dominion Energy South Carolina and Georgia Power plan nearly two hundred projects. Some, just miles apart.
caption: Along the Savannah River, Dominion Energy South Carolina and Georgia Power plan nearly 200 projects. Some, just miles apart.

text: In twenty twenty-four, federal regulators issued a rule, because planning in isolation leads to waste, and delays.
caption: In 2024, federal regulators issued a rule, because planning in isolation leads to waste and delays.

text: So we built GridLock Atlas.
It reads a hundred and three public documents, and puts both plans on one map, with every fact tied to a verbatim quote, and its page.
caption: It reads 103 public documents and puts both plans on one map, with every fact tied to a verbatim quote and its page.

text: Then it measures the closest points between every cross-utility pair of projects. Seven thousand, nine hundred and twenty-nine pairs.
caption: Then it measures the closest points between every cross-utility pair of projects. 7,929 pairs.

text: A naive rule, close, or same time, flags more than half of them. GridLock flags one hundred and forty-nine. Just one point nine percent.
caption: A naive rule, “close or same time”, flags more than half of them. GridLock flags 149. Just 1.9%.

text: One click compares the plans, and ranks every lead. Place first, then timing, then the strength of the evidence.
Number one: Dominion's Jasper to Oh-Katie line, and Georgia Power's Goshen to Mackintosh rebuild. Their closest points are four point two five miles apart.
caption: Number one: Dominion’s Jasper–Okatie line and Georgia Power’s Goshen–McIntosh rebuild. Their closest points are 4.25 miles apart.

text: And their published schedules overlap, for eighteen months.
caption: And their published schedules overlap for 18 months.

text: It's the pair from Sperry's own worked example. On today's plans, it ranks first.
In 3D, you can watch the two projects meet. On the ground, and in time.
caption: In 3D, you can watch the two projects meet. On the ground, and in time.

text: And it never overstates. Field work dates aren't published, so it says so. No coordination on record means unknown. Never, uncoordinated.
caption: And it never overstates. Field-work dates aren’t published, so it says so. No coordination on record means “unknown”. Never “uncoordinated”.

text: For any pair, one click writes a review brief. The question to ask, with every fact numbered to its source.
It estimates impact too, and cites every number. In Wisconsin, the state commission says two utilities' lines meet at one new substation.
caption: It estimates impact too, and cites every number. In Wisconsin, the state commission says two utilities’ lines meet at one new substation.

text: One terminal instead of two: an estimated nine to twelve million dollars.
caption: One terminal instead of two: an estimated $9–12 million.

text: And it's auditable. Sperry's worked example is reproduced exactly. Six of six rows.
caption: And it’s auditable. Sperry’s worked example is reproduced exactly: 6 of 6 rows.

text: As a cross-check, GPT five point five went through all two hundred and eighty-three plan pages. All but one of its two thousand, five hundred and seventy-nine quotes were verbatim.
caption: As a cross-check, GPT-5.5 went through all 283 plan pages. All but one of its 2,579 quotes were verbatim.
